name: Blue Current Human Operator Review Protocol
principle: Aim small, miss small — one job, one screen, one obvious next action.

ratingScale.CLEAR: The operator understood and completed the task without coaching.
ratingScale.FRICTION: The task completed, but hesitation, extra explanation, or avoidable taps were observed.
ratingScale.BLOCKED: The operator could not complete the task accurately or safely.

scenarios.job: Sign in, leave the app, and return to the same usable workspace.
scenarios.start: Authenticated session on an iPad or equivalent touch device.
scenarios.expected: Connectivity and session recover before interaction unlocks; no forced reload or duplicate action.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Lost operator time and service interruption.

scenarios.job: Find an expected guest and mark the party arrived.
scenarios.start: Guest appears in the current reservations or arrivals workflow.
scenarios.expected: The guest leaves the prior state once and appears in the correct active Host queue.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Missed reservations, guest wait, and host labor.

scenarios.job: Add a walk-in and understand the party's place in line.
scenarios.start: Active Host Stand during normal service.
scenarios.expected: Name and party size create one waitlist record with readable wait context.

scenarios.job: Choose an appropriate table and seat one party.
scenarios.start: Arrived or waitlisted party and at least one available table.
scenarios.expected: One guest and one table commit once; the Host card clears and the table becomes seated.
observe: party and table identity after seating
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Seat utilization, turn time, and mis-seat recovery.

scenarios.job: Recognize the newly seated party and begin service.
scenarios.expected: Service receives the same guest, party size, table, and seated time without re-entry.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Greeting speed, labor coordination, and guest retention.

scenarios.job: Advance one table through greeting, ordering, dining, and check milestones.
scenarios.expected: Only the selected table advances one human-confirmed stage per action.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Throughput, check timing, and server capacity.

scenarios.job: Mark an ordering handoff ready and deliver the correct food.
scenarios.start: Known Service party in Ordering with a matching Kitchen handoff.
scenarios.expected: Kitchen Ready promotes the matching table without advancing Service automatically.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Food quality, remake exposure, and table pace.

scenarios.job: Complete service, clean the table, and return it to available.
scenarios.start: Party at the final Service milestone on a seated table.
scenarios.expected: Service completion moves seated to cleaning; a human reset moves cleaning to available.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Table turns, sanitation control, and available capacity.

scenarios.job: Identify and act on the first real Service recovery exception.
scenarios.start: Known Service stage exceeds its configured recovery threshold.
scenarios.expected: The actual party and table appear first with one concrete recovery action and no invented cause.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Guest recovery cost, comps, and repeat-visit risk.

scenarios.job: See, own, follow up, and complete a Service recovery action.
scenarios.start: An active Service recovery exception has synchronized.
scenarios.expected: One high-priority live action appears; ownership and completion affect only that action.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Recovery follow-through and management span of control.

scenarios.job: Identify the first attendance exception and record follow-up.
scenarios.start: Live time-clock data contains a late or missing clock-in condition.
scenarios.expected: The first real exception, employee identity, and one follow-up action are visible.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Labor deployment, overtime exposure, and service coverage.

scenarios.job: Run the primary workflow under a simulated rush on the target iPad.
scenarios.start: Multiple active parties, exceptions, and simultaneous workspace activity.
scenarios.expected: Text remains readable, touch targets remain reliable, scrolling remains controlled, and the first priority stays obvious.
scenarios.profitabilityLens: Peak throughput, training time, mistakes, and abandoned demand.
